mapper.select: SELECT ci AS user_seq_no, bank_code_tran, bank_name, balance_amt, available_amt, account_type, product_name FROM mock_bank_account WHERE fintech_use_num = #{fintechUseNum}

SELECT t.tran_date, t.tran_time, t.inout_type, t.tran_type, t.print_content AS printed_content, t.tran_amt, t.after_balance_amt FROM mock_bank_transaction t JOIN mock_bank_account a ON a.mock_account_id = t.mock_account_id WHERE a.fintech_use_num = #{fintechUseNum}
AND TIMESTAMP(t.tran_date, t.tran_time) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{fromDate}, #{fromTime}), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{toDate}, #{toTime}), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')
AND t.tran_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
AND t.inout_type = '입금'
AND t.inout_type = '출금'
ORDER BY t.tran_date
ASC DESC
, t.tran_time
ASC DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_account WHERE org_code = #{orgCode}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(reg_date), '%Y%m%d') FROM mock_account WHERE org_code = #{orgCode}

SELECT b.currency_code, b.saving_method, DATE_FORMAT(b.issue_date, '%Y%m%d') AS issue_date, DATE_FORMAT(b.exp_date, '%Y%m%d') AS exp_date, b.commit_amt, b.monthly_paid_in_amt FROM mock_account_basic b JOIN mock_account a ON a.account_num = b.account_num AND a.seqno = b.seqno WHERE a.org_code = #{orgCode} AND b.account_num = #{accountNum} AND b.seqno = #{seqno}
